description: Anamaduwa Pradeshiya Sabha - Roads and Lanes Owned by the Anamaduwa Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with land and property matters, specifically the declaration and affirmation of roads and lanes as owned by the Pradeshiya Sabha (local council). It involves land registrations, property ownership (of roads), and the legal process of affirming these assets, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). The content does not involve government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories.
